name: Scroll Reveal

mode.description: scrub follows scroll position both ways; once reveals on entry with a word stagger.

start.description: Viewport fraction where scrub progress is 0.

end.description: Viewport fraction where scrub progress is 1.

stagger.description: Per-word delay in ms, once mode.

duration.description: Reveal duration in ms, once mode.

a11y: The word-split copy is aria-hidden; a visually hidden __sr span carries the original text once, in full.
Links and other inline elements inside the block are kept in the visual copy and stay focusable there; the sr copy is plain text, so they are not duplicated in the tab order.
At baseOpacity the dim pre-state is a deliberate design choice; once a word is fully revealed, contrast is the author's own.
Reduced motion skips the word split entirely, so the block reads at full opacity with no blur from the start and no scroll listener is attached.
